subject: Project Palisade kickoff - reverse thinking for small reasoners
body:
Team,

Kicking off the RevThink productization. We're running this internally under the codename Project Palisade - please use it in subject lines and planning docs so the threads are easy to track.

The method, from our open-source release: a teacher model generates forward reasoning, backward questions, and backward reasoning for each training item; students fine-tuned on that augmented data become measurably stronger reasoners. The repo covers eight tasks (SQA, CSQA, ARC, MATH, GSM8K, TabMWP, ANLI, Date), which gives us a broad eval out of the box.

Why it matters: our small-model line loses deals on reasoning quality, and Palisade is the cheapest credible fix - data augmentation, not architecture work.

Milestones: augmentation pipeline reproduced by March 13; mistral-7b student trained on at least four tasks by April 17; go/no-go for the full student refresh by May 29.

Alina - staffing and teacher-compute plan please.

Dmitri
